24018-the-golfer-s-rubaiyat.creator: H.W. Boynton
24018-the-golfer-s-rubaiyat.description: A book by H.W. Boynton. Bunker blows, And many a Willie rules us, just the same. VI    A THOUSAND lips are lockt; but still in hoar High-balling Andrew's Shrine, with "Fore, fore, fore! Oh, fore!" the Golfer to the Duffer cries, That reddened cheek of his to redden more. VII    COME, choose your Ball, and in the fire of Spring Your Red Coat, and your wooden Putter fling;   The Club of Time has but a little while To waggle, and the Club is on the swing.

25171-the-uncalled.title: A Novel
25171-the-uncalled.creator: Paul Laurence Dunbar
25171-the-uncalled.description: A book by Paul Laurence Dunbar. s a slim woman, and her straggling, dusty-coloured hair hung about an unpleasant sallow face. She shaded her eyes with her hand, as if the faint light could hurt those cold, steel-grey orbs. "It 's mornin'," she said to those within.

arxiv-1909-00873.title: Reducing the dichromatic number via cycle reversions in infinite digraphs
arxiv-1909-00873.creator: Paul Ellis, Attila Joó, Dániel T. Soukup
arxiv-1909-00873.description: Abstract We prove the following conjecture of S. Thomassé: for every (potentially infinite) digraph D D it is possible to iteratively reverse directed cycles in such a way that the dichromatic number of the final reorientation D ∗ D^{*} of D D is at most two and each edge is reversed only finitely many times.

arxiv-2102-11402.title: MixUp Training Leads to Reduced Overfitting and Improved Calibration for the Transformer Architecture
arxiv-2102-11402.creator: Wancong Zhang, Ieshan Vaidya
arxiv-2102-11402.description: Abstract MixUp is a computer vision data augmentation technique that uses convex interpolations of input data and their labels to enhance model generalization during training. However, the application of MixUp to the natural language understanding (NLU) domain has been limited, due to the difficulty of interpolating text directly in the input space.

arxiv-2105-09567.title: Unified Dual-view Cognitive Model for Interpretable Claim Verification
arxiv-2105-09567.creator: Lianwei Wu, Yuan Rao, Yuqian Lan, Ling Sun, Zhaoyin Qi
arxiv-2105-09567.description: Abstract Recent studies constructing direct interactions between the claim and each single user response to capture evidence have shown remarkable success in interpretable claim verification. Owing to different single responses convey different cognition of individual users, the captured evidence belongs to the perspective of individual cognition.

arxiv-2402-01402.title: A comparison study of supervised learning techniques for the approximation of high dimensional functions and feedback control
arxiv-2402-01402.creator: Mathias Oster, Luca Saluzzi, Tizian Wenzel
arxiv-2402-01402.description: Abstract Approximation of high dimensional functions is in the focus of machine learning and data-based scientific computing. In many applications, empirical risk minimisation techniques over nonlinear model classes are employed. Neural networks, kernel methods and tensor decomposition techniques are among the most popular model classes.

arxiv-2408-13955.title: Hawking radiation inside a charged, cosmological black hole
arxiv-2408-13955.creator: Devayani Ravuri, Tyler McMaken
arxiv-2408-13955.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Devayani Ravuri, Tyler McMaken. We study the effective temperature, as a rate of gravitational redshift, of the Hawking modes perceived by a radially free falling observer at an arbitrary location in a Reissner-Nordström-(anti-)de Sitter [RN(A)dS] spacetime. In particular, the behavior of the modes at the inner horizon, and therein the validity of the strong cosmic censorship conjecture under the effective temperature formalism, has been analyzed across the physically permissible parameter space of the RNdS metric.

arxiv-2508-01694.title: Performance and Storage Analysis of CRYSTALS - Kyber (ML-KEM) as a Post - Quantum Replacement for RSA and ECC
arxiv-2508-01694.creator: Nicolas Rodriguez Alvarez, Fernando Rodriguez Merino
arxiv-2508-01694.description: Abstract The steady advancement in quantum computer error correction technology has pushed the current record to 48 stable logical qubits, bringinga us a little closer to machines capable of running Shor’s algorithm at scales that threaten RSA and ECC cryptography.

arxiv-2509-00902.title: Quantum action of the Josephson dynamics
arxiv-2509-00902.creator: Cesare Vianello, Sofia Salvatore, Luca Salasnich
arxiv-2509-00902.description: Abstract We study the beyond-mean-field Josephson dynamics of the relative phase between two coupled macroscopic quantum systems. Using a covariant background field method, we derive the one-loop only-phase quantum effective action and the corresponding equation of motion for the quantum average of the phase.

arxiv-2511-09818.title: Lumos3D: A Single-Forward Framework for Low-Light 3D Scene Restoration
arxiv-2511-09818.creator: Hanzhou Liu, Peng Jiang, Jia Huang, Mi Lu
arxiv-2511-09818.description: Abstract Restoring 3D scenes captured under low-light conditions remains a fundamental yet challenging problem. Most existing approaches depend on precomputed camera poses and scene-specific optimization, which greatly restricts their scalability to dynamic real-world environments. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Lumos3D, a generalizable pose-free framework for 3D low-light scene restoration.

arxiv-2602-21019.title: Expregular functions
arxiv-2602-21019.creator: Thomas Colcombet, Nathan Lhote, Pierre Ohlmann
arxiv-2602-21019.description: Abstract Polyregular functions form a robust class of string-to-string functions with polynomial growth, as evidenced by Bojańczyk (2018). This class admits numerous descriptions and enjoys several closure properties. Most notably, polyregular functions are regularity reflecting ( i.e. the inverse image of a regular language is regular).

kropotkin-modern-science-anarchism-model.creator: Peter Kropotkin (David A. Modell, trans.)
kropotkin-modern-science-anarchism-model.description: Kropotkin's 1903 philosophical testament — anarchism grounded in the inductive-deductive method of modern natural science — in David A. Modell's translation (Social Science Club of Philadelphia).

pmc-11390932.title: Investigating screw-agitator speed ratio impact on feeding performance in pharmaceutical manufacturing using discrete element method
pmc-11390932.creator: Luz Nadiezda Naranjo Gómez, Kensaku Matsunami, Paul Van Liedekerke, Thomas De Beer, Ashish Kumar
pmc-11390932.description: In continuous powder handling processes, precise and consistent feeding is crucial for ensuring the quality of the final product. The intermixing effect caused by agitators, which alters the powder’s bulk density, flow rate, and flow patterns, plays a significant role in this process, yet it is often overlooked.

pmc-11479950.title: SPHK2 Knockdown Inhibits the Proliferation and Migration of Fibroblast-Like Synoviocytes Through the IL-17 Signaling Pathway in Osteoarthritis
pmc-11479950.creator: Jiaxuan Zheng, Xiaolong Xiong, Ke Li, Guangji Wang, Huiyuan Cao, Hui Huang
pmc-11479950.description: ObjectiveSynovial inflammation is vital for the progression of osteoarthritis (OA). The objective of this study was to explore the effects and potential molecular mechanisms of sphingosine kinase 2 (SPHK2) on the proliferation and migration of fibroblast-like synoviocytes (FLS).MethodsA TNF-α-stimulated FLS model and a papain-induced OA rat model were constructed.

pmc-11715070.title: Uptake of Medicare’s Annual Wellness Visit and Cognitive Screening: Evidence of Urban‐Rural Disparity from a National Survey
pmc-11715070.creator: Ying Liu, Soeren Mattke
pmc-11715070.description: BackgroundEarly‐stage cognitive impairment remains severely under‐detected. In the U.S., Medicare covers an Annual Wellness Visit (AWV) that includes assessment of cognitive state, but it remains under‐utilized: only 55% of beneficiaries reported having had AWV, of whom only 26% were given a structured cognitive test in 2019. We obtained updated estimates and analyzed association with beneficiary characteristics.

pmc-11716578.title: Central Autonomic Dysfunction and Plasma Ab42/40
pmc-11716578.creator: Trevor Lohman, Arunima Kapoor, Allison C Engstrom, Fatemah Shenasa, Amy Nguyen, John Paul M Alitin, Aimée Gaubert, Kathleen E Rodgers, David Bradford, Mara Mather, Duke Han, Elizabeth Head, Julian F Thayer, Daniel A Nation
pmc-11716578.description: BackgroundHigher order regulation of autonomic function is maintained by cortical and subcortical interconnected regions within the brain, collectively referred to as the central autonomic network (CAN) (Benarroch, 1993). Despite the well‐established relationship between autonomic dysfunction and AD (Femminella et al., 2014) the relationship between CAN functional connectivity and biomarkers of AD, such as Ab42/40 ratio, remains unexplored.

pmc-12629064.title: Biomarkers influence kidney function estimates more so than race among persons with HIV
pmc-12629064.creator: Peggy-ita A Obeng-Nyarkoh, Amanda B Spence, Richard Teran, Christopher A Loffredo, Bruce Luxon, Joseph Timpone, Princy Kumar, Jason G Umans, Seble G Kassaye
pmc-12629064.description: BackgroundWe sought to understand the results of using different estimating equations (with and without a “race” category) and the addition of cystatin C as a biomarker on Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) stage estimates among persons with HIV (PWH), for whom CKD is an important comorbidity.MethodsBiomarkers were measured in this cross-sectional single site U.S. clinic-based study from 2014 to 2016.

pmc-13433936.title: Defect-mediated n-type to p-type transition and enhanced thermoelectric performance in Bi1.8−xNixSb0.2Te3 alloys
pmc-13433936.creator: G. Poojitha, P. Poornesh, Ashok Rao, C. L. Hung, Y. K. Kuo, Om Prakash, Dhanya Sunil
pmc-13433936.description: A systematic investigation pertaining to the low temperature (10–350 K) thermoelectric properties of Ni substituted Bi1.8−xNixSb0.2Te3 alloys (x = 0–0.08), it was synthesised employing solid state reaction method. X-ray diffraction studies verified the presence of phase pure rhombohedral structures. FESEM micrographs showed a morphological transition from hexagonal platelets to granular networks as the Ni content increased.

pmc-13567127.title: Crystalline and Amorphous Cerium Phosphate Nanoparticles as Enzyme-Mimetic Nanomaterials for Regenerative Medicine
pmc-13567127.creator: Ekaterina V. Silina, Artem S. Chizhov, Maria P. Kruglova, Alexey A. Kryukov, Svetlana A. Dodonova, Maksim A. Pugachevskii, Natalia E. Manturova, Victor A. Stupin
pmc-13567127.description: Wounds represent a persistent challenge in modern medicine, driving the search for novel nanomaterials capable of modulating oxidative stress and promoting tissue regeneration. While cerium oxide nanoparticles have been extensively studied for their enzyme-mimetic activity, hydrated cerium orthophosphates remain relatively unexplored despite their promising biocompatibility and redox properties.

[FR Doc No: 99-1670] ----------------------------------------------------------------------- DEPARTMENT OF THE TREASURY [Treasury Order Number 102-10] Designation of Chief Information Officer for the Department of the Treasury January 13, 1999. By virtue of the authority vested in the Secretary of the Treasury by 31 U.S.C. 321(b), 44 U.S.C. 3506, and sections 5125 and 5131 of the Clinger-Cohen Act.

uslaw-usc-t5-s13124.title: 5 U.S.C. § 13124 — Rules and regulations
uslaw-usc-t5-s13124.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t5-s13124.description: United States Code, Title 5 (Government Organization And Employees); Part IV (Ethics Requirements); Chapter 131 (Ethics In Government); Subchapter II (Office Of Government Ethics). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In promulgating rules and regulations pertaining to financial disclosure, conflict of interest, and ethics in the executive branch, the Director shall issue rules and regulations in accordance with chapter 5 of this title.
